questions.question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

The mother as well as her children were brought to the police station for interrogation.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is -** 'Her children were brought'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the error lies in the wrong usage of **subject-verb agreement.**
 
• If the **subject **is joined with **as well as** the verb will agree with the **first subject.** 
 
• Here, the first subject is **The mother** (singular) then we will use the **singular verb** which is **was.**
 
 
• **Example:** *Ram as well as his mother is coming.*
 
 
 
• In the above example as well as is connected with** Ram** which is **singular** so here we will use** Is.**
 
• If the **subject** is joined by **as well as, along with, together with, in addition to, beside, but, except, rather than, accompanied by, like, unlike, no less than, nothing but,** the verb will agree with the **first subject.**
 
• Use of **was/were**
 
 
• **Was:** He/she/it/name/singular.
 
• **were:** you/we/they/all/plural.

 
 
 

The correct sentence will be:* The mother as well as her children was brought to the police station for interrogation.*

​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f1d776c4ca45212685ca0930c2539d73a1d70923a3eebad6480bea0298a95b3.png] 

 
• दिए गए वाक्य में, त्रुटि विषय-क्रिया subject-verb agreement. समझौते के गलत उपयोग में है। 
 
• यदि विषय के साथ-साथ क्रिया को भी जोड़ा जाता है तो क्रिया पहले विषय first subject. से सहमत होगी।
 
• यहाँ, पहला विषय है माँ (एकवचन) Singular फिर हम एकवचन क्रिया का प्रयोग करेंगे जो कि wasथा।
 
 
• Example: *Ram as well as his mother is coming. *(उदाहरण: राम और उसकी माँ भी आ रहे हैं।)
 
 
 
• उपरोक्त उदाहरण में और साथ ही राम के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है जो एकवचन (singular) है इसलिए यहाँ हम Is का उपयोग करेंगे।

 

**सही वाक्य होगा: ***The mother as well as her children was **brought** to the police station for interrogation.*

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and make a grammatically correct sentence.

I tried to contact her two or three times but _______ time there was no reply.
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 1) i.e. Each.**

• 'Both' is used when two things are referred together.
 
• 'All' means every.
 
• 'Any' means one of the following options.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and make a grammatically correct sentence.

Chris and I play tennis together regularly, but ________ of us can play very well.
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 4) i.e. neither.**

 
• The sentence uses 'but' which means that the speaker introduces a contradictory statement after 'but'.
 
• We can reject options 1 and 2 as they would give the sentence positive meanings. 
 
• None is used when there are multiple options and not even one is true, hence option 3 is also rejected.
 
• **Neither is used when there are two options and not even one is true. **It means 'not the one nor the other of two people or things; not either.'
 
• Here, we have two people. Hence, we will use **'neither'**.
 
• So, only option 4 is correct.

• The correct phrase would be** 'not expected'.**
 
• So, only option 1 is correct.

questions.question: Yuvraj has got more marks than Shakti. Neha has got less marks than Anamika. Swapnil has got more marks than Adil. Yuvraj gets less marks than Adil. Anamika and Shakti has got equal marks. Aditya has got more marks than Adil but less than only one person in the group. Who has got the highest and lowest marks?
questions.solution:
1. Yuvraj has got more marks than Shakti.

Yuvraj > Shakti = Anamika

2. Neha has got less marks than Anamika.

Anamika > Neha

3. Swapnil has got more marks than Adil.

Swapnil > Adil

4. Yuvraj gets less marks than Adil.

Adil > Yuvraj

5. Anamika and Shakti has got equal marks.

Anamika = Shakti

6. Aditya has got more marks than Adil but less than only one person in the group.

___ > Aditya > Adil

On combining all the six statements together, we get:

**Swapnil > Aditya > Adil > Yuvraj > Shakti = Anamika > Neha**

Hence, ‘Swapnil – highest, Neha – lowest’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a class of 70 students, 40 students have passed in Philosophy, 36 have passed in History, 10 students have failed in both the subjects. How many students have passed in Philosophy only?
questions.solution:
Number of students who passed = 70 – 10 = 60

Given: 40 students have passed in Philosophy, 36 have passed in History

Number of students who passed in both the subjects = (40 + 36) – 60 = 16

Number of students who passed in Philosophy only = 40 – 16 = 24

Hence, ‘24’ students have passed in Philosophy only.

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by four conclusions as options. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which conclusion logically follows from the statements.

**Statements:**

All roots are plants.

No plant is fruit.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3685b52f49b0b42916b156886c9bff3274044af84fa9d46f50c81420febac276.png] 

1) No plant is root → False (As it is given all roots are plants)

2) Some fruits are roots → False (As all roots are plants and No plant is fruit.)

3) No fruit is root → True (As all roots are plants and No plant is fruit)

4) Some roots are not plants → False (As it is given all roots are plants)

Hence, only 3rd option is true.

questions.question:
Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

54 – 45 ÷ 9 + 7 × 11 = 14
questions.solution:
Given equation: 54 – 45 ÷ 9 + 7 × 11 = 14

1) 7 and 54, + and –

After interchanging 7 and 54, + and –, we get:

L.H.S = 7 + 45 ÷ 9 - 54 × 11

= 7 + 5 – 51 ×11

= 7 + 5 – 561

= 12 – 561

= -549 ≠ R.H.S

2) 9 and 11, - and ÷

After interchanging 9 and 11, - and ÷, we get:

L.H.S = 54 ÷ 45 - 11 + 7 × 9

= 1.2 – 11 + 63

= 64.2 – 11

= 53.2 ≠ R.H.S

**3) 54 and 45, + and × **

**After interchanging 54 and 45, + and ×, we get:**

**L.H.S = 45 – 54 ÷ 9 × 7 + 11**

**= 45 – 6 × 7 + 11**

**= 45 – 42 + 11**

**= 14 = R.H.S**

4) 45 and 11, ÷ and ×

After interchanging 45 and 11, ÷ and ×, we get:

L.H.S = 54 – 11 × 9 + 7 ÷ 45

= 54 – 99 + 0.156

= 54.156 – 99

= -47.844 ≠ R.H.S

Hence, ‘54 and 45, + and ×’ is the correct answer

questions.question: The average of 25 numbers is zero. At most, how many of these numbers can be greater than zero?

Average = Sum of observation/Number of observation

Let the 25 number be x₁, x₂, x₃, ......., x₂₅

According to the question,

The average of 25 numbers is zero

⇒ (x1 + x2 + x3 + .......+ x25)/25 = 0

⇒ x1 + x2 + x3 + .......+ x25 = 0

⇒ x1 + x2 + x3 + .......+ x24 = - x₂₅

It means Atmost 24 number is greater then zero.

**∴ 24 numbers can be greater than zero.**

questions.question: What is the total surface area of a cone which has a radius of 21 cm and a height of 28 cm? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The given radius r = 21 cm and height h = 28 cm form a scaled 3:4:5 right-angled triangle triplet (multiplied by 7).

Hence, the slant height l = 5 × 7 = 35 cm.

Total Surface Area = πr(l + r)

TSA = (22 ÷ 7) × 21 × (35 + 21) = 66 × 56 = 3696 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 3696 cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the cone (r) = 21 cm

Height of the cone (h) = 28 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d775239939d3c5bece01cae30ef753a890b4743a0f31ff27335401f3476ec33.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Slant height (l) = √(r² + h²)

Total Surface Area (TSA) = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r)

**Calculations:**

⇒ l = √(21² + 28²)

⇒ l = √(441 + 784)

⇒ l = √1225 = 35 cm

⇒ TSA = (22 ÷ 7) × 21 × (35 + 21)

⇒ TSA = 22 × 3 × 56

⇒ TSA = 66 × 56

⇒ TSA = 3696 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 3696 cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cone

The capacity of a cone is one-third that of a cylinder with the same base and height: V = (1 ÷ 3)πr²h.

Curved Surface Area

The lateral or curved surface area of a cone is given by: CSA = πrl, where l is the slant height.

Frustum of a Cone

When a cone is cut by a plane parallel to its base, the lower part is a frustum. Volume = (1 ÷ 3)πh(R² + r² + Rr) and CSA = πl(R + r).

questions.question: In a mixture of 100 litres of milk and water, the ratio of milk and water is 3 : 2. If this ratio is to be 1 : 1, how much more water is to be added to the mixture?
questions.solution:

Ratio of milk and water = 3 : 2

Quantity of milk in the mixture = (3/5) × 100 = 60

Quantity of water in the mixture = 100 - 60 = 40

Let the quantity of water add in the mixture be x litres.

According to the question

60/(40 + x) = 1/1

⇒ 60 = 40 + x

⇒ x = 60 - 40

⇒ x = 20 litres

**Short Trick:**

Ratio of milk and water = 3 : 2

New ratio of milk and water = 1 : 1 or 3 : 3

Taking water ratio

⇒ 3 - 2 = 1 unit

⇒ 2 + 3 = 5 unit = 100

⇒ 1 unit = 100/5 = 20 litres.

questions.question: Which Index is used by RBI to decide repo rate and measure Inflation?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 1**, i.e., **__CPI__**

 
• The **Wholesale Price Index (WPI)** was the main index for measurement of inflation in India **till April 2014** when RBI adopted a new **Consumer Price Index (CPI)** (combined) as the key measure of inflation.
 
• The **CPI calculates the difference in the price** of commodities and services such as food, medical care, education, electronics, etc, which Indian consumers buy for use.
 
• **Inflation **refers to the rise in the **prices of most goods and services of daily or common use**, such as food, clothing, housing, recreation, transport, consumer staples, etc. I**nflation measures the average price change** in a basket of commodities and services over time.
 
• The opposite and rare fall in the price index of this basket of items is called ‘**deflation**’. Inflation is indicative of the **decrease in the purchasing power** of a unit of a country’s currency. This is **measured in percentages**.
 
• These are some of the chief reasons for the increase in prices:
 
 
• **High demand and low production or supply of multiple commodities** create a demand-supply gap, which leads to a **hike in prices**.
 
• Excess circulation of money leads to inflation as **money loses its purchasing power**.
 
• With people having more money, they also tend to spend more, which causes increased demand.

questions.question: Financial emergency provisions of the Indian Constitution have been borrowed from ___________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Constitution of Germany**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The provision relating to **Financial Emergency (Article 360)** in the Indian Constitution has been borrowed from the **Constitution of Germany (Weimar Constitution)**.
 
• A Financial Emergency can be proclaimed by the President if the **financial stability or credit of India or any part thereof is threatened**.
 
• During a Financial Emergency, the Union Government can issue directions to states regarding financial matters.
 
• The President may also direct a reduction in the salaries and allowances of government employees, including judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts.
 
• Notably, **no Financial Emergency has been declared in India so far**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Canadian Constitution**:

 
 
• Inspired provisions such as the **strong Centre**, appointment of state governors by the Centre, and advisory jurisdiction of the Supreme Court.
 
 
 
• **Irish Constitution**:
 
 
• Inspired the **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)**, nomination of members to the Rajya Sabha, and the method of election of the President.
 
 
 
• **American Constitution**:
 
 
• Inspired the **Fundamental Rights**, judicial review, independence of the judiciary, and the impeachment process of the President.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Article 352** – National Emergency.
 
• **Article 356** – President's Rule / State Emergency.
 
• **Article 360** – Financial Emergency.
 
• **Financial Emergency provision borrowed from Germany (Weimar Constitution)**.
 
• **No Financial Emergency has been imposed in India till date.**

questions.question: Which of the following physical Quantity - SI unit pairs is correctly matched?
questions.solution:
**__CONCEPT:__**

__
 
• **Physical quantity **is a property of a material. It can be expressed in number by measurement.
 
• A physical quantity is expressed by a numerical value and a unit. For example, the physical quantity length can be expressed as 4 metre, where 4 is the numerical value and metre is the unit.
 
• The SI units are the standard units of measurement defined by the International System of Units (SI).

**EXPLANATION:__**

Following are the SI units of the physical quantity:

 
 

 **Physical Quantity**
 **SI Units**
 
 

 Power
 watt
 
 

 Inductance
 henry
 
 

 Capacitance
 farad
 
 

 Force
 newton
 
 

 Mass
 kilogram
 
 

 Resistance
 ohm
 
 

 Energy, work
 joule
 
 

So The correct answer is option 4 i.e. Force - Newton.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13f14e6b52a8b9b9e8c8e9d07e0be40281e8f2cff51d43e05270c8298d964dfd.png] 

 
• **litre **unit of Volume is **not** part of SI unit system.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49db1e88466c4075382b1073285f91a9ab0332e48bb5db4e537f337fc9ab0472.png] **

 
• The name and symbol of SI units are written in **lowercase**.
 
• Except the symbols of those SI units, named after a person, which are written with an initial capital letter.
 
• For example, the second has the symbol s, but the kelvin has symbol K, because it is named after Lord Kelvin.
